content:
incident-bot: [PAGER] billing-counter-jitter detected: cohort 'api-prod' showing +12-30% delta between emitter and ledger for last 15m. 3 customers flagged for potential overage. Paging on-call.
priya_oncall: seeing the bot. I'm on it. Assigning to @liam for billing triage, @emily for infra checks.
liam: pulling emission vs ledger logs now. hitting kafka consumer lag on usage-events (group=billing-emitter). offsets ~150k behind. looks like emitter had restart at 01:23 UTC.
emily: checking nodes. autoscaler triggered restart of emitter-3 due to OOM at 01:22. repro: memory spike during heavy batching. logs -> /var/log/emitter-3/oom.log
caroline-support: getting customer pings: one customer saw 'potential overage' email. we should pause overage notifications ASAP.
priya_oncall: agreed. @matt can you pause billing alerting webhook and silence alerting rule? :pray:
matt: silenced alerting rule billing.overage.alert until 02:30 UTC. webhook gateway paused for 'overage' alerts. :white_check_mark:
liam: running quick recon script to reconcile last 1h counts: 
```
python tools/reconcile_counts.py --start=2026-03-17T00:00Z --end=2026-03-17T01:00Z --cohort=api-prod
```
results show emitter undercounted 28k tokens for that interval due to commit lag; ledger has delayed writes, causing duplicate forward-fill later.
emily: starting controlled restart of emitter with increased heap and reduced batch size. will roll emitter-3 -> emitter-0 then monitor.
liam: starting live backfill job to reingest missing events from kafka (offsets 1234000..1234150). kicking off:
```
kubectl run -i --rm backfill --image=redwood/recon:latest -- python backfill.py --topic usage-events --from-offset 1234000 --to 1234150
```
ETA ~8m.
caroline-support: holding customer notifications. drafting note: "We detected transient metering inconsistency; counts are being reconciled; customer impact minimal, no charges yet. We'll follow up in 2h."
priya_oncall: good. after backfill completes, liam please run compare_count_summary and post delta. if delta < 0.5% we un-silence alerts, else keep silenced and run full reconcile job.
liam: backfill started. will post summary in ~10m.
deploy-bot: deployment event: emitter-3 restarted by emily at 2026-03-17T01:29:12Z (sha:abc123). healthchecks passing.
liam: backfill finished. compare_count_summary -> emitter vs ledger delta = 0.12% for api-prod, 3 customers' temporary flags cleared. no billing actions required. posting recon artifacts to /incidents/1758642099/recon/
priya_oncall: closing pager. silenced rules -> unsilenced. @caroline please send the brief to affected customers and CC infra.
caroline-support: sent. included rollback timeline, reconciliation summary, and reassurance no charges applied. ticket #INC-2026-175864 open for follow-up.
priya_oncall: thanks all. postmortem to include emitters batching config, OOM mitigation, and alerting thresholds. assigning to liam/emily. :v:
